meta.description: Professional portfolio of Abraham Asael Puch Kuk — B.Sc. in Information Technology

highlights: Administration and maintenance of enterprise ERP system, ensuring operational availability and data consistency.
Level 2 technical support: diagnosis and resolution of infrastructure and software incidents.
SQL Server database administration: query optimization, referential integrity maintenance and report generation.
Desktop application development in C#/.NET (Windows Forms) for internal process automation.
Design and implementation of scripts for workflow automation and recurring operational tasks.
Report creation and data analysis using the Microsoft Office suite.
Design and implementation of an e-commerce platform with client-server architecture.
Full-stack development of a regional transportation reservation system, including inventory management and transaction processing.

skills.label: Programming Languages
skills.details: Java, C#, C++, PHP, Python and JavaScript. Proficient in web technologies (HTML, CSS) and data formats (JSON, XML, YAML). Experience consuming and integrating RESTful APIs.

skills.label: Databases
skills.details: Relational and non-relational data modeling. Experience with MySQL, SQL Server, MariaDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Schema design, query optimization and database engine administration.

skills.label: Frameworks & Libraries
skills.details: .NET, MAUI, Spring Boot, CodeIgniter, Bootstrap, Django, Tailwind CSS, NumPy, Pandas and Matplotlib.

skills.label: Infrastructure & DevOps
skills.details: Administration of Windows and Linux environments. Version control with Git. Containerization with Docker.

skills.label: Artificial Intelligence
skills.details: LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Minimax). AI Agents (OpenCode, Antigravity, Codex). Prompt engineering, MCPs, Agent Skills. Local model deployment (llama.cpp, Ollama).

skills.label: Office & Tools
skills.details: Proficient with the Microsoft Office suite for report creation and data analysis. Experience with multimedia editing software and file management tools.

skills.label: Interpersonal Skills
skills.details: Strong adaptability and rapid acquisition of new technologies and methodologies. Effective collaboration in results-driven, multidisciplinary teams.

activities: Self-taught study of physics and discrete mathematics.
